$schema_note: Machine-readable availability/capability matrix for the Banzami Developers Sandbox/Preview documentation. Single conservative source checked by tests and mirrored by the PT/EN docs credential matrices. States: available_controlled_sandbox | documented_preview | pending_e2e | simulated | not_public | not_available | not_approved. This file describes the CURRENT Sandbox/Preview scope only — it is not a Production contract and makes no production/live/external-provider availability claim.

console_auth_workspaces_projects_members.note: Sign-in (email + OTP), workspaces, projects, members/roles/invites, test keys (reveal-once, rotate, revoke).

console_visual_pages.note: Dashboard, webhooks UI, logs UI are demo previews with illustrative data — not operational.

developer_api_key.note: bz_test_ keys, direct Bearer; bz_live_ rejected fail-closed; no Production key issuance.

payment_sessions.note: Requires payment_sessions scope + ACTIVE project binding (or a merchant credential).

payment_links.note: Requires payment_links scope + ACTIVE project binding (or a merchant credential).

webhook_configuration.note: Endpoint registration/inspection APIs exist for merchant credentials; not public for developer keys.

webhook_outbound_delivery.note: Simulated in the public E2E suite (emission, HMAC signing and retry contract verified; DOA journey is the verified delivery path). Not claimed as publicly active.

refunds.note: Verified end-to-end with a merchant credential; developer-key scope refunds:write is pending E2E — a developer-key request is rejected (403).

transfers.note: Verified with an authenticated user; developer-key scopes transfers:* are pending E2E.

production_live_rails.note: Production in preparation. No real money. No production key issuance.

pay_checkout_live_rails.note: Public pay/checkout surfaces are not available and not approved for restore.

external_provider_rails.note: No external provider is activated; activation is a separate governance decision.
